# External Repositories

This directory is for cloning external repositories for reference during development.
Contents are gitignored except this README and .gitkeep.

## Recommended Repos to Clone

### FreeCAD Source (for API reference)
```bash
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD.git
```

### Existing FreeCAD MCP Implementations
```bash
# neka-nat's implementation (XML-RPC based)
git clone https://github.com/neka-nat/freecad-mcp.git

# Other implementations for reference
git clone https://github.com/jdickey1954/freecad-mcp.git jdickey-freecad-mcp
```

### Vision Models
```bash
# Segment Anything 2
git clone https://github.com/facebookresearch/segment-anything-2.git

# For VLM reference
git clone https://github.com/NVIDIA/Cosmos.git
```

## Notes

- These repos are for development reference only
- Do not commit any cloned repos
- Each repo may have its own license - check before using code
